description: This Java class defines constants used for configuring access to an AMQP network in the Hono example project. It includes default hostnames, ports, tenant IDs, and command interval settings, primarily as static final variables with some dynamic configuration via system properties.

classes.name: HonoExampleConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing configuration constants for connecting to and interacting with the Hono AMQP network in the example setup.
